text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? What's that floating around over there...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Could it be a fairy?!
Or maybe a Japanese yokai?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, to think I would finally meet you—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah... So it was just a plastic bag...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Ahem, environmental issues.
It seems this is indeed an agenda item that demands our priority...
